# Rafiq v0.4.29: Rafiq works on your issues

Twelve trackers, a model that picks up issues and starts tasks with your approval, and issues
that move along on their own while the work happens.

---

## 🔗 Twelve trackers

- **Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, YouTrack, Bitbucket,
  Gitea and Plane.** Each one reads, searches, comments, changes status and creates issues;
  a table in Integrations shows what else each one supports.
- **Sign in with a code** for GitHub and GitLab (OAuth device flow), or paste a token as before.
  Tokens stay in the Windows keychain.
- **Read only.** One switch per account, and nothing is ever written to it.

## 🤖 The model works with your issues, and asks first

- **In any chat** the model can read an issue, split it into subtasks, create, edit, link and
  comment on issues, attach files and log time.
- **It starts tasks itself:** background tasks and schedules it creates, lists, edits and stops.
- **Every write asks you first.** A card in the chat shows what it wants to do, with
  **Allow**, **Deny** and **Always allow**.
- **Settings → Permissions** holds your choices: creating tasks, writing to trackers, publishing
  to Git and posting to your team's chat, each one "ask" or "always allow".

## 🚦 Issues that move along with the task

- **"Do it" on an issue** starts a task in the right folder (you map projects to folders once).
- The issue moves to **In Progress** when the task starts and to **In Review** (or **Done**) when
  it finishes.
- The task works on a **branch named after the issue**, then commits, pushes or opens a **pull
  request** that closes it, whichever you pick.
- It can post its plan before it starts, a summary of what it did when it finishes, and the time
  it took.

## 🗂️ A Work page

- **List and board.** Drag a card between columns to change its status. Select several issues
  to change them together.
- **A side panel** with the details, the work Rafiq did on the issue and the comments.
- **Waiting for my review**, **Notices** and **saved views** in the tracker's own query language.
- **Create an issue** with **Ctrl+N**.

## 🔔 Notices and rules

- **Rafiq watches your accounts:** assigned to you, mentioned, review requested, new comments,
  status changes. In the app and as Windows notifications.
- **Rules:** when a new issue assigned to you matches a label, a project or a word in the title,
  Rafiq prepares a task, a plan you approve, or just tells you.
- **Your team's chat:** Slack, Microsoft Teams and Discord webhooks for notices and finished
  tasks. The model can post there too, for example a morning summary from a schedule. Only the
  official webhook addresses are accepted.

## ↩️ A log you can undo

- **Every change Rafiq makes on a tracker is logged**: who asked, what changed and when. Status
  changes, edits, closed issues and comments can be undone from the log, where the tracker allows it.

## ⬆️ Updates

- **A new version has to be installed.** When an update is out, the app shows what's new and
  installs it with one button. Tasks stopped by the restart can be continued from where they stopped.

---

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. For a new install, download
`Rafiq_0.4.29_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.4.29_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
